user.title: Shelly Pro 3EM Bridge
user.description: Configure the MQTT source and the virtual Shelly device identity.

data_description.device_mac: Must be unique on your LAN, e.g. 5C:CF:7F:AA:BB:01. Changing this after setup requires re-adding the bridge in the Shelly App.
data_description.mqtt_topic: The MQTT topic that publishes the current power consumption as a plain numeric value in Watts.
data_description.http_port: Port the virtual Shelly device HTTP/WebSocket server listens on. MUST be 80 for the Shelly App network scan. Only change if port 80 is occupied (Nginx SSL add-on); then use manual device-add in the Shelly App.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.port_in_use: Port is already in use. Choose a different port.

abort.already_configured: A bridge with this MAC address is already configured.

data_description.cloud_enabled: Enable to push power data to the Shelly Cloud. Required for Zendure Hyper 2000 Smart CT mode. The real Shelly Pro 3EM must be disconnected!
data_description.cloud_key: JWT token extracted from the real Shelly via GET /rpc/Shelly.GetDeviceInfo?ident=true
data_description.cloud_server: Shelly Cloud WebSocket server address (usually auto-detected)

error.cloud_key_required: Cloud JWT Key is required when cloud is enabled.
